rules.verification_command_format: shell-command (must be an exact, runnable line); not a natural-language step

status_legend.in_progress: The feature is the current active task (WIP=1: only one at a time).
status_legend.blocked: Cannot continue until a documented blocker is resolved.
status_legend.done: Required verification has passed and matching evidence is recorded.
status_legend.abandoned: Decided not to ship; left for record-keeping.

features.title: Part I walking skeleton and tester desk
features.user_behavior: A human plays Part I gates 1–7 in the Player against real canon; a tester flags a scene; an author inspects the run and attaches a storyboard prompt in the Console; the drifter bot reaches every Part I gate by date.

features.title: Canon proposals with diff and approval
features.user_behavior: An author submits a canon proposal with a diff and validation report; approve writes through YAML; reject stores the reason; Player never sees proposals.

features.title: Incidents and felt conditions (first-night rain)
features.user_behavior: After Jonas flirts through her, Elena leaves embarrassed and only then the rain starts; failed cover soaks her; soaked blocks walking home and unlocks gallery upstairs; changing can be recorded; spice level changes how a follow-up is shown, not which flags or leverage fire.

features.title: Taken-conduct follow-up: Tilde VIP demand
features.user_behavior: On a dark route Elena can film Tilde with two guests; after sending the recording to Tilde a follow-up offers reveal-to-the-other versus film-someone-else; spice changes only the depicted proof.

features.title: Console entity editor with proposal preview
features.user_behavior: An author searches canon, opens an entity as YAML, previews a diff and validation report, then queues a proposal; nothing writes until approve; Player never sees the catalogue.

features.title: Rehearsal desk with findings
features.user_behavior: An author runs a scripted rehearsal from the Console; the report names gate scenes never entered and files those as findings; Player never sees rehearsals.

features.title: Findings become proposal drafts
features.user_behavior: An author turns a finding into a pending canon proposal for that entity; a rehearsal can opt in to queue those drafts; nothing writes until approve; Player never sees the queue.

features.title: Remaining scripted rehearsal bots
features.user_behavior: An author runs completionist, romantic, detective, or saint from the Console; each policy picks differently; Player never sees rehearsals.
verification_commands: pnpm exec vitest run packages/rehearsal tests/contract/rehearsal.test.ts --reporter=dot

evidence.ref: pnpm exec vitest run packages/rehearsal tests/contract/rehearsal.test.ts --reporter=dot
